title: California Insurance Code Section 10509.958 (delivery and signature of the illustration)
updateCadence: Amended only by legislation. The section credit on the official host at the time of access read Added by Stats. 1996, Ch. 1106, Sec. 1. Effective January 1, 1997, with the section operative July 1, 1997 pursuant to Section 10509.965.
claims: Section 10509.958(a) requires that, if a basic illustration is used in the sale and the policy is applied for as illustrated, a signed copy be submitted to the insurer at the time of application and a copy be provided to the applicant, and that if the policy is issued other than as applied for, a revised basic illustration labeled Revised Illustration be sent with the policy and signed no later than the time the policy is delivered.

Section 10509.958(b) requires that, if no illustration is used in the sale or the policy is applied for other than as illustrated, the producer certify that in writing on a form provided by the insurer, the applicant acknowledge that an illustration conforming to the policy as issued will be provided no later than policy delivery, and a basic illustration conforming to the policy as issued be sent with the policy.
Section 10509.958(d) requires the insurer to retain the signed illustrations and any certification until three years after the policy is no longer in force.
